_note: The well-known DNS-root analog for the RAPP network. Pure-raw discoverable at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/RAPP/main/.well-known/rapp-network-seed.json. Sniffers BFS from this seed across operators' beacons (each beacon's federation_hints[] adds new nodes). No Search API required; no rate limits for public raw URLs.
observation_note: The original network description and operator references are retained verbatim as historical data exhaust. Moving-branch URLs are unverified observations only and must never establish membership, identity, trust, freshness, or RAPP/1 acceptance.
constitutional_article: Article XLVII — Discoverability Without A Central Registry

reference_state._note: commit_pin and sha256 pin the beacon at beacon_url. A reader follows the beacon's own commit-pinned estate_url, which tools/sniff_network.py lets win over estate_url here; estate_url and grail_url stay moving observations and are not used for acceptance. The pinned commit must be reachable from kody-w/rapp-estate main (its draft branch experimental/rapp1-distributed-hive merged without rewriting). historical_beacon_url keeps the moving URL recorded before the pin.

federation_context.historical_behavior: Operator beacons could publish federation_hints[] for breadth-first observation.
federation_context.empty_reason: No concrete federation hint values were recorded in this seed revision.

self_replication_note: Anyone can fork kody-w/RAPP and host their own seed at <handle>/RAPP/main/.well-known/rapp-network-seed.json. Sniffers can start from any seed; the network is a graph, not a tree.
how_to_add_yourself: Open a PR against kody-w/RAPP modifying this file. Include your github handle, estate_url, beacon_url, and (optionally) grail_url. Or — preferred — get listed in some other operator's beacon's federation_hints[] and the next sniff pass will pick you up transitively.
submission_effect: A PR or federation hint is a reviewable observation draft only. It does not create network membership, operator identity, trust, registry acceptance, or replication authority.
